i.norm: Verifies that when an offset beyond the buffer length is given, the stream reports 0 available bytes even after calling mark(). The buffer has 8 bytes but offset 358 exceeds it, so the internal position is clamped to the end-of-buffer. After mark() is called (with any readLimit), available() must still return 0 because no bytes remain to be read.
mark() with a negative readLimit is accepted by this implementation
